title: Recht auf Löschung
description: As a user, I want my account and personal references to be deletable, so that my personal data is removed when I request it.

acceptance_criteria.given: a user authored three prompts and holds an active session
acceptance_criteria.when: the organisation admin triggers the erasure
acceptance_criteria.then: the account, its tokens and its sessions are deleted and the authorship in the three prompts is anonymised
and: the prompts themselves remain and are queued for a new scan
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-029-right-to-erasure.feature: Erasing a user removes the account and anonymises authorship

acceptance_criteria.given: a user belongs to organisation B
acceptance_criteria.when: an admin of organisation A attempts the erasure
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 403 and nothing is deleted
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-029-right-to-erasure.feature: A user of another organisation cannot be erased

acceptance_criteria.given: the erased user performed security relevant actions
acceptance_criteria.then: the audit entries remain with actor and timestamp but without the personal reference and without content
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-029-right-to-erasure.feature: Erasure does not destroy the audit trail
